sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_api_id) 
FROM Player_Attributes pa 
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id 
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986' AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'high'
